rca of the issue: Pre-fix RCA: 'Sinus Lift' was missing from CLINICAL_EXAM_GROUP in /app/frontend/constants/checklist.ts. Because of that, `isClinicalExamGroup` was false for Sinus Lift cases, so the Intraoral Examination subtree (line 1978 in new-procedure.tsx — Occlusocervical Height / Mesiodistal Space / Ridge Contour inputs) never rendered. BUT the form-completeness validator at line 1367 — `!isFullArch && !isOverdentureNonFullArch` — required those exact fields for any non-full-arch non-overdenture case (Sinus Lift qualifies). Result: validator demanded fields the UI never showed → 'Clinical Examination has missing fields' message could never clear → Continue button stayed disabled. Fix: added 'Sinus Lift' to both CLINICAL_EXAM_GROUP and NON_FULL_ARCH_TYPES so the render gate and validator gate agree. Verified at code level (both sets contain 'Sinus Lift') and at DOM level (Treatment Plan + Prosthetic Plan + Clinical Examination sections now render for Sinus Lift on the live frontend).
